Jab sab haar maan lein, tabhi asli grit dikhta hai.
Himmat kuch nahi maangti.
Grit ka matlab apne kal ke liye tike rehna.
Khamoshi man ko darshati hai.
Jo kabhi mistake nahi karta—wo kuch naya try hi nahi karta.
Grit sabse bade toofan ko maat deti hai.
Khamoshi violence ko consent deti hai.
Himmat mein jaadoo aur taqat hai.
Himmat moments me napti hai.
Khamoshi ki aawaz hi sabse geheri garjan hoti hai.
Khali bartan sabse zyada shor karte hain.
Chup raho; wise raho; brave raho.
Darr ek pratikriya hai, par himmat ek faisla hai.
Courage greatness ki first virtue hai.
Grit mansik majbooti hai.
Saat baar girna, aathvi baar khada hona.
Bahadur woh jinke fear hota hai, par purpose bhi milta.
Himmat pehli fazilat hai.
Courage i resistance to fear, mastery of fear—na absence of fear.
Courage ek repeat hone wala choice hai.
Himmat darr ka na hona nahi.
